view2: แสดงคานคอดิน พื้น เสา ชั้นล่าง — ground beams B1-B6, B4', slab marks S0/S1/S4 (beam_plan)
warnings: Each column position prints a footing+column pair ('F3,C3', 'F2,C1', 'F2,C2', 'F1,C1'): 24 positions = 8 F3C3 + 7 F2C1 + 2 F2C2 + 7 F1C1. Footings and their column marks are recorded as separate point elements (same positions).
Row ค has no footing at grids 4, 5, 6: the building edge steps in to line ข''' (0.60 above ค) there — confirmed on the ground-beam plan, where B4' stubs end at ข''' and no column is drawn on row ค.
Footing/column sizes are not printed on this plan; they come from the footing details (S-06/S-08) and column details.
